title: From First Shot to Fire Mage and Ogre Siege

clips.why: Clear first combat wave showing drag-to-aim controls without tutorial text
Red explosive barrel detonation wipes out a pack of goblins
Upgrade popup lets the player recruit the Fire Mage
Fire Mage joins the defense from the left tower
Tougher dark-armored enemies and denser waves escalate the pressure
Intense final defense against large ogres storming both walls
